errors.evidence: The description does not state the label of the horizontal axis, which is "Години" (Years).
The y-axis label is "Хиляди лева", not the abbreviation "Хил. лв.".

errors.text_span: През 2018 г. разходите са около 14500 хил. лв., през 2020 г. са около 13000 хил. лв.
errors.evidence: The values for 2018 and 2020 are underestimated. The bar for 2018 is visibly above the 14500 line (approx. 14600), and the bar for 2020 is visibly above the 13000 line (approx. 13100).
